source_set_digest_format: SHA256 of concatenated sorted UTF-8 lines: file_sha256 + two spaces + relative_path + newline. Excludes target/ and this report.
changes: Distinct darwin-wayland-client-input package/binary; registry package versions/checksums unchanged.
Real wl_seat/keyboard/pointer event observers and pure state verifier added; no injection/device backend.
Frozen SSD negotiation and original pixel workload/buffer-release discipline preserved.
Client output labels every input observation origin=host_pdserialhid; no physical-typing claim.

contract.required_server: Existing compositor launched --input pdhid after actual PDSerialHID queue priming; this client does not open queues or establish priming.
contract.ready: One seat, version >=5 bound <=9, exact keyboard+pointer capabilities; real XKB v1 keymap file observed; own keyboard focus with empty held keys; all modifiers/group zero; acknowledged SSD; real frame callback.
contract.keymap: Regular fd with declared 2..1048576 bytes, backing length >=declared, exact read, trailing NUL, UTF-8/no embedded NUL and four expected XKB text sections. FNV1a64 identity diagnostic. No semantic XKB parser or cryptographic keymap binding claimed.
contract.sequence: After single DL10_INPUT_READY, within 15000 ms: evdev A(30) press/release, pointer enter on own surface at local(200,100) +/-1 pixel per axis, BTN_LEFT(272) press/release at that point, pointer.frame.
contract.proof: DL10_INPUT_OBSERVED NONCE origin=host_pdserialhid only after exact input sequence. Logs actual serial/time, pointer enter/motion and button coordinates. No global position/drag proof is emitted.
contract.rejections: Wrong capabilities/focus, preheld keys, nonzero modifiers/group, pre-ready input, unknown/wrong/extra key/button, out-of-tolerance click/motion, scroll, missing pointer frame or input deadline are sticky failures. Later errors invalidate complete proof even after an earlier marker.
contract.drag_compatibility: A pointer leave after completed content click is permitted for future server-owned titlebar drag; any extra client button/key fails. Host should leave neutral pointer at final titlebar point after drag, not issue another content click.
contract.exit: Normal deadline/close requires complete input and frame proof; otherwise nonzero. Normal object teardown retains decoration-before-toplevel. Closing this observer does not close compositor PDGOP/PDHID ownership.
contract.source_attribution: host_pdserialhid is the experiment label. Device provenance cannot be established by a Wayland client; independently bind future host TX ledger, exact candidate, guest launcher, phase order, full capture and Linux recovery.
contract.deadline_limit: Initial registry roundtrip remains inherited/blocking; independent host worker deadline mandatory. Host must gate on actual readiness, not socket existence.

checks.scope: 5 inherited SSD mode tests +9 pure input/keymap tests; Linux host test binary compilation, no live compositor or input device
Source wiring, original/SSD preservation, unchanged dependency pins and pixel workload; not runtime evidence
